statement: ∀ p ∈ circle, ∃! g, g ∈ SO2 ∧ (g 0 0, g 1 0) = p
script:
# name: set-so2-orbit-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Surjective.SO2_orbit_bijective
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['(1, 0)', '(by norm_num [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle])'], True, "have key : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ circle), ∃! g, g ∈ SO2 ∧ (g 0 0, g 1 0) = p := by
  intro p hp
  simp only [circle, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hp
  refine ⟨!![p.1, -p.2; p.2, p.1], ⟨?_, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff, Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff']
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> linarith
    · rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]; linarith
  · rintro g ⟨hg, hgp⟩
    rw [SO2_eq_of_column g hg, ← hgp]
exact @key ((1, 0)) ((by norm_num [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle]))"),
    (['(0, 1)', '(by norm_num [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle])'], False, "have key : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ circle), ∃! g, g ∈ SO2 ∧ (g 0 0, g 1 0) = p := by

    rw [SO2_eq_of_column g hg, ← hgp]
exact @key ((0, 1)) ((by norm_num [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle]))"),
    (['(3/5, 4/5)', '(by norm_num [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle])'], False, "have key : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p ∈ circle), ∃! g, g ∈ SO2 ∧ (g 0 0, g 1 0) = p := by

    · rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]; linarith
  · rintro g ⟨hg, hgp⟩
    rw [SO2_eq_of_column g hg, ← hgp]
exact @key ((3/5, 4/5)) ((by norm_num [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Sets.circle]))"),
